title: Abnormal cases on the network side

entities.name: EMM INFORMATION message
entities.description: A NAS message that could not be delivered due to handover and may be retransmitted by the MME.

entities.name: Intra MME handover
entities.description: A handover procedure within the same MME that may cause non-delivery of NAS PDUs.

entities.name: TAI list
entities.description: Tracking Area Identity list used to determine if the target TA is included.

entities.name: S1 signalling connection exists
entities.description: Condition indicating that the S1 signalling connection is still active.

entities.name: Handover procedure failure
entities.description: Condition reported by lower layers indicating handover procedure failed.

entities.name: MME retransmits EMM INFORMATION message
entities.description: Behavior where the MME retransmits the EMM INFORMATION message under specific conditions.

relations.description: Intra MME handover may cause non-delivery of the EMM INFORMATION message.
If target TA is in TAI list and handover completes successfully, MME retransmits the message.
If handover fails and S1 connection exists, MME retransmits the message.
S1 connection existence is required for MME retransmission after handover failure.
MME retransmission behavior establishes the sending of EMM INFORMATION message.
